title: DIR-2024-4351-BSA-1A
text:
DIR-2024-4351-BSA-1A  Council District: 15 – McOsker
  CEQA: N/A
  Plan Area: Wilmington – Harbor City

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  832 North Dominguez Avenue
  (837, 839, 843 and 845 North Sanford Avenue)

  The Harbor Area Planning Commission (HAPC) originally heard this case on June 3, 2025. The case
  was remanded back to the HAPC, by the Los Angeles County Superior Court in the case of JE Real
  Estate Holding Company, LLC v. City of Los Angeles (Case No. 25STCP02924), with a Judgment
  and Writ of Mandate ordering the HAPC to vacate its decision memorialized in its October 21, 2025
  Letter of Determination, enter a new decision denying the appeal, and reinstate Permit Nos. 18020-
  10000-03711, 19030-10000-00551, 21020-10000-00018, and 21020-10001-00018.

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  An appeal of the Department of Building and Safety action of issuing permits to establish an open storage,
  truck and trailer parking with associated automobile parking.

  APPEAL:
  An appeal of the March 5, 2025 Planning Director’s Determination which:
  1. Found, pursuant to Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC) Section 13B.10.2., that the Los Angeles
  Department of Building and Safety (LADBS) did not err or abuse their discretion in issuing Permit Nos.
  18020-10000-03711, 19030-10000-00551, 21020-10000-00018, and 21020-10001-00018 to
  establish an open storage truck and trailer parking with associated automobile parking.

  Property Owner: JE Real Estate Holding Company, LLC ℅ Glenda Lima Valdez

  Appellant:  Citizens for a Better Wilmington
  Representative: G. Martinez

  Staff:  Undine Petrulis, Associate Zoning Administrator
  undine.petrulis@lacity.org
  (213) 978-1170

  Timothy Fargo, Associate Zoning Administrator
summary: The Harbor Area Planning Commission will rehear a neighborhood group's appeal of permits for open truck and trailer storage and parking at 832 North Dominguez Avenue in Wilmington, after a court ordered it to deny the appeal and reinstate the permits.
